regions.merged_text: Consumption Disapears To-day May 19th Miss Hazel Heenan of 149 Davenport St. Detroit reports her Brother Philip out of danger. Said Brother Philip Heenan 45 yrs old examined April 9th by Dr. Williams of Cold Water, Michigan who shows by X-ray consumption positively to be in one lung -- both in rear and front. Shortly before said X-ray he had been enrolled first time and spots seem- ingly healed appeared to be heale ..... enrolled 2nd time and now all appearance of consumption has vanished.

regions.merged_text: Fractured Scull Oscar St. Pierre, 23 of Chatham Ont. (BearLine) fell between trolley-cars on April 12th receiving bad fracture of scull. Taken to Hospital he remains unconscious five days, till on the 16th is enrolled perpetually. Comes To-day in perfect condition to thank for prayers, etc. Left Hospital (Hotel Dieu) May 4th Deo Gr!

regions.merged_text: Paralysis? Miss Erma Peterson non cath. 20 of 6590 Montererey Ave. Enrolled this evening for Paralisis of whole right side and limbs - weeps with Mother. Sunday 1.30 p.m. returns weeping for joy at improvement Monday 13th can walk pretty well Sunday June 19 says herself: "I can walk very well."

regions.merged_text: Awakes after 7 Weeks Sleep. Mrs. George C. Anderson N. Cath 49 (Yrs) 1508 Montclair, received paraletic stroke of the brain October 1st, 1926. An invalide and helpless till February 1st slept for 7 weeks. A Catholic friend enrolled her in S.M. Asso'n Dur last week of March she began to show signs of consciousness. First - Was up and in quite perfect health for Easter and, Thank God, continues so.
